title: Understanding MSE and MAE
text: Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) are both measures of prediction accuracy. MSE squares the differences between predicted and actual values, while MAE takes the absolute value of these differences. Consider how these differences might affect the optimization process.

title: Gradient Descent and MAE
text: Gradient descent is a method used to minimize a function by iteratively moving towards the steepest descent. Think about how this method might apply to minimizing the absolute differences in MAE.
